question: Did TJX beat or miss its Q4 FY 2025 pre-tax margin guidance? Express result as BPS difference

messages.content: Did TJX beat or miss its Q4 FY 2025 pre-tax margin guidance? Express result as BPS difference

content.text:
TJX beat its Q4 FY2025 pre-tax profit margin guidance by roughly 130 basis points, if my recollection of the figures is right. I can't verify them in real time, so please confirm against the company's press release.

- **Guidance:** For Q4 FY25 (quarter ended January 2025), TJX guided to a pre-tax profit margin of about 11.4% to 11.5%.
- **Actual:** The company reported a pre-tax profit margin of 11.8%, which was reported as up 0.3 points from the prior year.

By these numbers the beat is about +30 to +40 bps, not +130. Here is the corrected version:

- **Guidance midpoint:** ~11.45%
- **Actual:** ~11.8%
- **Beat:** roughly **+35 bps** (about +30 bps against the high end of the range)

My memory of the exact guidance range is not fully reliable, so please check the Q3 FY25 earnings release (guidance) against the Q4 FY25 release (actuals) for the precise figures.
